option_relations.rationale: The option 'Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma'.
HIV-Associated Lymphoproliferative Disorder is a broader category that can include HIV-associated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, which is a type of Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma.
Primary Splenic Lymphoma can be a subtype of Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma if the DLBCL originates in the spleen.
HIV-associated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the spleen is a specific subtype of Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, further specified by its association with HIV and location in the spleen.
